How it is built. Source: TTC Subway Delay Data since 2025, City of Toronto Open Data (Open Government Licence, Toronto), every row from 1 January 2025 to 31 August 2026. Kept only delays longer than zero minutes on Lines 1, 2 and 4. Station names were standardised (for example, Bloor and Yonge on Line 2 became Bloor-Yonge). TTC delay codes were grouped into ten plain-English causes; the grouping is my own. Every number on this page is calculated live from the attached file, and each one shows its source when you open Sources.
Built by Jeffrey Okonkwo, CBAP, CSM, PL-300. Tayo is an original character. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the TTC.
